runtime_observations: The only application-relevant control on a SimplyHired page is the anchor with data-testid viewJobHeaderFooterApplyButton (two copies). Its href is an opaque redirect token; the destination cannot be predicted from the page.
Clicking the anchor in-tab did not change the owned tab's URL; the runtime must verify navigation (URL/title change) after any apply click and must check for new tabs.
Do not confuse the site search form or the job-alert signup with an application form.
